reference_default_experiment: JSONv2 is true in internal/buildcfg/exp.go even with an empty GOEXPERIMENT environment value
facade_scope: Policy value construction and typed number/raw/custom-capability adapters are active default capabilities reviewed alongside the historical declaration forms; this is not a claim to implement all encoding/json/v2 or encoding/json/jsontext declarations.

source_dependencies.purpose: Unicode print/space diagnostics and typed record name folding

checkpoints.scope: Generic typed capability callbacks, records, nullable values, lists/fixed arrays, Bool/String/I64/F64/validated numbers/raw fragments. Built-in map/binary/unsigned catalogue and effect adapters remain open.

All signed/unsigned machine integer widths, binary byte slices/fixed byte buffers, independent numeric/binary observations and actual SWAR word qualification. Binary32, map/key, dynamic and effect capabilities remain open.

Persistent balanced typed maps, explicit scalar/raw-byte/JSON-valued keys, original quoted key views, key normalization/sorting before value callbacks, partial updates and invalid-value metadata. Binary32, dynamic convenience descriptors, general numeric string casts, complete method/error adapters and effects remain open.

native_map_adaptations.ordering: JsonKey supplies a stable total application comparator; JsonMap is immutable balanced storage. Encoding sorts normalized UTF-8 names independently of application order. Equal encoded names preserve application comparator order; no unspecified reference tie order is promised.
native_map_adaptations.key_methods: json-key and json-byte-key supply explicit text/name conversion callbacks. json-json-key composes typed JSON methods with numeric stringification and rejects nonstring resulting tokens. json-unsupported-key is an explicit deny-capability, not an inferred runtime method set.
native_map_adaptations.partial_updates: JsonDecoded retains the partial persistent map, first error and continuation state; source-backed JsonMember key views preserve original quoted spans.
native_map_adaptations.ownership: Input documents and raw conversion results are independently owned. Key-name snapshots precede every value callback. Keys must keep stable ordering while stored; no hidden capacity or alias mutation is imitated.
native_map_adaptations.invalid_values: JsonInvalidValueError records an invalid encoding state with no fabricated application value or type label. Typed labels remain explicit capabilities rather than reflection objects.
